summary: Using the variational (Rayleigh quotient) principle for the Sturm–Liouville problem (P u')' + q u + λu = 0 with Dirichlet BCs, show eigenvalues satisfy λ > -q_max; then apply it to diffusion with position-dependent coefficient D(x) on a rod with zero boundary values to find the limit of n(x,t) as t→∞.
